name: Meta Ads
description: Meta's advertising platform; the Marketing API (Graph API) manages campaigns, ad sets, ads, audiences, creatives and insights across Facebook/Instagram.
access_notes: Creating a Meta app and calling the Marketing API against your own ad account is self-serve (standard access to ads_read/ads_management; new apps get the 'Limited Access' Marketing API tier by default, described as development access with heavy rate limits). Production/scale is gated: managing other people's ad accounts requires Advanced Access via App Review + business verification, and the 'Full Access' Marketing API tier requires 500+ successful API calls in the past 15 days with <15% error rate.
mcp_notes: Meta hosts an official Ads MCP server at https://mcp.facebook.com/ads (part of 'Meta ads AI connectors', open beta since April 2026) using Meta Business OAuth — no developer app registration needed, though rollout is phased per ad account. Composio catalog also lists a Meta Ads toolkit (METAADS, 53 tools, OAUTH2/API_KEY) plus a broader Facebook toolkit.
uncertainty_notes: Access tokens (user, system user, page) are OAuth-issued bearer tokens sent in the Authorization header — recorded as oauth2_authorization_code + bearer_token. Webhooks evidence is for leadgen (Page object) notifications documented inside the Marketing API lead-ads guides; general ad-object change webhooks are more limited. The hosted MCP server's phased rollout means some ad accounts see is_ads_mcp_enabled=false.

evidence.note: Standard access to ads_read/ads_management suffices for managing your own ad account; advanced access (App Review) required to manage other people's ad accounts; Full Access tier requires 500+ calls/15 days and <15% error rate.
New apps get Limited Access tier by default ('development access'); upgrade to Full Access via App Review for production rate-limit quota.
Marketing API guide for real-time leadgen webhooks (subscribe Page object, leadgen field).
Official docs: 'ads MCP server is a Meta-hosted Model Context Protocol server... remote-hosted at https://mcp.facebook.com/ads'.
Meta Business Help Center page on managing ads from an AI agent via the ads MCP server and CLI.
